invariants.rationale: Methods related to commits generally require a meaningful instantTime; a null value would be unexpected at commit time.
partitionRecordsMap is passed to commitInternal, so it must be non-null prior to return.
This covers all possibilities, ensuring method safety; a more interesting invariant would need further semantic context.
Typically, instantTime represents a commit timestamp or identifier, which is expected to be non-empty.
The keySet of a non-null map should itself be non-null, ensuring safe further processing based on partition names.
